chapter_seo_title: Wang Chan Poisoned & Han Li Escapes – A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 264
chapter_meta_description: Wang Chan’s blood-cloud backfires—he’s poisoned by his own chase. Han Li escapes but immediately regrets not finishing the fight. Plus, a rival sect steals Wang Chan’s prisoners.
og_title: Ch. 264: The Poisoned Pursuit – A Mortal’s Journey
og_description: Wang Chan chases Han Li but his own blood-cloud poisons him. Han Li escapes—then kicks himself for not killing the bastard. Oh, and someone stole Wang Chan’s prisoners.
twitter_description: Wang Chan’s chase backfires hard. Han Li escapes but misses a killing stroke. Plus, political chaos. Classic Mortal Stream irony.

lore_anchors.definition: A sealed portion of a real magic treasure’s power, usable by weaker cultivators but permanently consumed with each use.
A high-speed escape technique that burns the user’s essence blood for explosive speed.
A powerful water-element demon beast; its poison is extremely potent and can be refined into killing tools.
A toxic smoke refined from venomous materials; Han Li added ink flood dragon poison to it, making it even deadlier.
One of the Six Demonic Sects; specializes in dual cultivation and is infamous for its predatory recruitment of beautiful cultivators.
Elite warriors of the Ghost Spirit Sect; used for security and assassination tasks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Wang Chan get poisoned by his own blood-cloud?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The blood-cloud had absorbed the Greenfire Miasma, which Han Li had refined with ink flood dragon poison. When Wang Chan absorbed the cloud back into his body during the chase, the poison entered his system.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Wang Chan abandon the golden skull Talisman Treasure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He had used it many times before and believed it was nearly drained of power, so it wasn’t worth risking his life to retrieve it.
Second son of the Joyous Union Sect’s sect leader, a notorious “flower thief” among the younger generation. He stole the two female cultivators Wang Chan had captured.
